# Rafiq v0.5.15: Rafiq is on your phone now

## New
- **Rafiq from your phone.** Send your computer a task from the Android app, choose the model, follow each step, and approve or deny any command or change. The work runs on your computer.
- **Encrypted between your devices.** The service only carries encrypted messages. Your files and model keys never reach it.
- **Rafiq account.** Settings → Rafiq account: sign in with a code by email, link a phone with a QR code, and manage your devices and subscription.
- **Optional, at $9.99 a month.** This one service needs an account and a subscription. The rest of Rafiq stays free, with no account.

## The phone app
Android 8 or newer: [Rafiq-android.apk](https://github.com/AhmadALSaffan/RAFIQ/releases/download/android/Rafiq-android.apk). More at [rafiqagent.com/en/download](https://rafiqagent.com/en/download/).

## Updating
Rafiq offers the update by itself. Or download `Rafiq_0.5.15_x64-setup.exe` below and check it:

```powershell
Get-FileHash .\Rafiq_0.5.15_x64-setup.exe -Algorithm SHA256
```

Compare the result with `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
